ra: Trqqas is the storm-god of the Lycian pantheon.
Natri is a principal Lycian deity.
Lycian Maliya is a goddess of the Lycian pantheon.
The Twelve Gods are a collective cult within Lycian religion.
Eni Mahanahi, 'Mother of the Gods', is the chief mother-goddess of the Lycian pantheon.
Sozon is an Anatolian rider/savior god venerated in Lycia.
Trqqas is the Lycian reflex of the Luwian storm-god Tarhunz (interpretatio across the Luwic continuum).
Trqqas continues the wider Anatolian storm-god Tarhunt, of which Hittite Tarhunna is the cognate.
As the chief Anatolian storm/sky-god, Trqqas was identified with Zeus in Greek interpretatio of Lycian cult.
Natri is identified with Apollo in the Lycian-Greek bilingual inscriptions and coinage.
Lycian Maliya is a local reflex of the broader Anatolian/Luwian goddess Maliya; flagged as a homonymous but distinct cult.
Eni Mahanahi, 'Mother of the Gods', corresponds to the Anatolian Mother Goddess Cybele.
In Hellenized Lycia the mother-goddess of the Letoon was assimilated to Leto, mother of Apollo and Artemis.
The club-bearing rider-god Kakasbos was assimilated to Heracles in Roman-era Lycia and Pisidia.
The savior rider-god Sozon was identified with Apollo (Helios) in Anatolian votive dedications.
Sozon and Kakasbos share the same Anatolian club-bearing rider-god iconographic type.
As an armed warrior rider-god, Kakasbos is occasionally associated with martial deities such as Ares in regional cult, though Heracles is the primary equation.
